[page 1] A few pages of family history
Nicholas Lobig, Stupfield, 2008
The Löbigs were hatters in Flörburg, in Hesse. Eugen Löbig was a master hatter, and his son Sebastian, Wastl to everyone, born in 1862, was a hatter after him.
Wastl married Hildegard Laudler, Hilde, in 1905. Their children were Ursula, Klara and Gustav.
Ursula Löbig, the eldest, was born in 1911 and died in 1941. Klara, called Pünktchen, was born in 1917. Gustav, the youngest, was Gustl at home.
The Flörburg address book of 1912 also lists an Ursula Löbig, a widow at Angerring 57. Nobody in the family ever knew who she was.
[page 2] Klara left Flörburg first and settled in Stupfield. Gustl, my father, followed her in 1939 and became Gustave Lobig here, Gus to everyone.
Dad married Florence Faxridge in 1942. I was born in '50.
Dad died in '96 and he is buried here in Stupfield.
